name: kampalasmart-pos
description: KampalaSmart POS — offline-first, multi-tenant POS and business management platform

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @kampalasmart/api && npm run build -w @kampalasmart/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @kampalasmart/api" "npm run dev -w @kampalasmart/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @kampalasmart/api && npm run typecheck -w @kampalasmart/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @kampalasmart/shared && npm run test -w @kampalasmart/api
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w @kampalasmart/shared && npm run test:unit -w @kampalasmart/api
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
